Choose a nonempty affine open A_a in each (O cap C_a)^c and let S_j be the open substack of O lying over the affine scheme A := A_1 sqcup ... sqcup A_r (a finite disjoint union of affines is affine). Put Y^{(j+1)} := Y^{(j)} minus S_j with its reduced structure; it is closed in Y^{(j)}, hence in X. It is the union of the components of dimension < d_j together with the sets C_a minus S_j, each a proper closed subset of the irreducible C_a; hence dim Y^{(j+1)} <= d_j - 1 < n_j. Finally S_j = Y^{(j)} cap (X minus Y^{(j+1)}) is closed in X minus Y^{(j+1)} because Y^{(j)} is closed in X. Strict decrease of the dimensions forces termination with Y^{(N)} = empty. []

Because the n_j strictly decrease, **each integer occurs at most once** as a stratum dimension. This is what will bound the residual obligation by eight groups.

a pure polarizable Hodge structure of weight -16.

*Proof.* Apply (S2) to the smooth ambient V_{j+1} of pure dimension 21 and its smooth closed substack S_j of pure codimension c_j := 21 - n_j, at m = 26. Since m - 2c_j = 26 - 2(21-n_j) = 2n_j - 16, exactness gives

By (S5) the functor W_{26} is exact, so it commutes with kernels and images:
